claim_under_test: A wrong actor selection can simultaneously corrupt violation type, actor type, color, position, and lane (submitted paper, Section 5.2).
evidence_type: archived submission artifacts only — no ground truth is used, and none is available for the FETV test split
what_this_shows: That the twelve structured fields are not independently estimated: one upstream decision moves a block of six dependent fields together. It does NOT show which of the two records is correct.

date_time_fields_unchanged.note: Global scene attributes and overlay-derived metadata are identical in both records. Only the actor-centric block moves.

fetv_submission_v8.json.answer_description: On 2018-07-17 at 06:04:51, traffic moved normally through the four-way intersection with no violation.

fetv_submission_v11.json.answer_description: On 2018-07-17 at 06:04:51, a traffic incident occurred at a four-way intersection. A yellow car proceeded through the intersection against a red traffic signal, moving from lane 1 into lane 2 as it crossed from the top-left of the frame toward the middle-center in a red-light violation.

population_statistics.interpretation: In 51 of 200 clips (25.5%), the entire actor-centric block flips as a unit between two versions of the same system. Only 16 of the 67 clips with any dependent-field change show partial movement. The fields are effectively one decision, not seven.

why_this_matters_for_scoring: The official per-field scores were violation type 0.1578, violator type 0.3127, color 0.2434, initial/final position 0.1239/0.1278, initial/final lane 0.1780/0.1694, against weather and lighting at 1.0000 and date at 1.0000. Because the low-scoring fields are one coupled decision rather than seven independent estimates, their errors are correlated and a single upstream fix addresses all of them at once. Averaging them as independent fields understates how concentrated the failure is.
known_regression: v8 scored 0.4505 on the portal against v7's 0.4621. Its second pass flipped 40 clips from no_violation to a real violation and improved violation-type F1 from 0.1720 to 0.1944, but every cascade field fell, so the categorical mean dropped from 0.5061 to 0.4853. Populating the dependent block from a low-confidence violator guess scored worse than leaving it at the na default.
frame_rendering: Frames are not committed — the FETV clips are distributed through the challenge portal and their redistribution terms are not established. Render locally with scripts/render_case_studies.py --data-root /path/to/FETV_public_clips.
